body.name: Revenue from operations
body.description: Net revenue: revenue ledgers less returns, discounts and other reductions.

comparison.pctNote: Base is zero — % change not meaningful

body.name: Return on capital employed
body.description: Annualised EBIT ÷ average capital employed (equity + interest-bearing debt, opening & closing) × 100.

notes: Manual closing stock from Stock-in-Hand ledger(s) — used for financial statements in preference to item-level stock records.
Opening stock = Stock-in-Hand ledger opening balance.
No manual closing stock entered since the books start; the opening value is used for 2024-12-31.

body.name: Interest coverage
body.description: EBIT ÷ finance costs. Unavailable when there are no finance costs.

notes: Manual closing stock from Stock-in-Hand ledger(s) — used for financial statements in preference to item-level stock records.
Opening stock = Stock-in-Hand ledger opening balance.
No manual closing stock entered since the books start; the opening value is used for 2024-12-31.

body.name: Inventory days
body.description: Average inventory ÷ COGS × days in period.

notes: Manual closing stock from Stock-in-Hand ledger(s) — used for financial statements in preference to item-level stock records.
Opening stock = Stock-in-Hand ledger opening balance.
No manual closing stock entered since the books start; the opening value is used for 2024-12-31.

body.name: Cash runway
body.description: Cash & bank ÷ average monthly net cash outflow. Only shown when cash is declining.

notes: Cash is not declining over the period; runway not applicable.
